name: youtube
description: Finds music videos on YouTube (InnerTube, YouTube Music's video search) and hands them to the app's official YouTube player (the IFrame embed on youtube-nocookie.com). Nothing is downloaded and no stream is resolved: YouTube plays the video itself, with its own ads and its own counting, and the player stays on screen while it plays — YouTube's rules (D-086). No yt-dlp. The cover is the video's own thumbnail from `i.ytimg.com`.
